'''Tiyuu'cha Mahlor''' was a [[Minyavish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Qaras]]. In [[44 ABY]], he was exiled after the uprising of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] on Qaras along with the rest of his people. This revolution had been instigated by the organization [[Freedom Flight]], which was secretly founded by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]] to follow through the resulting crises by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. He was first [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] then [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Lecersen's [[IT-O interrogation droid/Legends|IT-O Interrogator]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] after the interrogator had successfully obtained a code from Mahlor to his safe-deposit box, where Mahlor stored compromising materials to [[Lecersen Conspiracy|Lecersen's Conspiracy]] group.
